description: This file contains a PHP unit test class 'security_utilsTest' which tests the functions in security_utils.php related to module access and user permissions within a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment.

classes.name: security_utilsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for utils/security_utils.php, focusing on user permissions, module access, and environment-specific behaviors.

methods.name: testquery_module_access_list
methods.description: Tests the function query_module_access_list with a mock user and compares the actual list of modules accessible to expected list.

methods.name: testquery_user_has_roles
methods.description: Tests whether query_user_has_roles correctly reports the number of roles for a user.

methods.name: testget_user_allowed_modules
methods.description: Tests get_user_allowed_modules returns an empty array for user '1'.

methods.name: testget_user_disallowed_modules
methods.description: Tests get_user_disallowed_modules returns expected modules that are not in the allowed list for user '1'.

methods.name: testquery_client_ip
methods.description: Checks query_client_ip for correct IP detection depending on server variables.

methods.name: testget_val_array
methods.description: Verifies get_val_array correctly transforms an associative array into an array of its keys.
